svg.title: The LEVER Framework for Entrepreneurs — Stop Watching, Start Winning
svg.desc: A one-page visual framework showing five sequential stages for entrepreneurs to find and deploy AI leverage: Landscape, Exposure, Value and Viability, Experiment, Roll-out and Review.
svg.text: A five-stage process for entrepreneurs and small business owners to find and win with AI
Start with your work. Not the tools.

g.text: Where does value get created — and where does it leak?
Hours on work that isn't the job
Which friction points does AI actually reach?
Which opportunities are worth pursuing, and in what order?
Does this actually work in my specific context?
How do we deploy this well — and keep it that way?

svg.text: Judgment work — Ambiguous, relational, stays human
"The organizations winning with AI are not the ones with the most tools. They are the ones who know exactly where the leverage is."
